# /kb — {{TITLE}}

Engine (below: `KB`), resolved once per session in this order (check each path with `ls`):
1. **Central**, installed with the **kb-setup** meta skill: `uv run ~/.claude/skills/kb-setup/scripts/kb.py` when `~/.claude/skills/kb-setup/scripts/kb.py` exists (Windows: `$HOME/.claude/...`).
2. **Workspace copy**: `uv run scripts/kb-engine/kb.py` when this workspace has one.
3. **Neither**: the KB cannot be queried. Explain why and offer to install kb-setup with `npx skills add wagnerpinheiro/graphify-kb --skill kb-setup -g -a claude-code` (needs Node.js; run it only after the user confirms; then open a new Claude Code session so the skill loads).

With only the workspace copy, consultation and `update` work, but curation that needs the meta skill (`/kb-setup upgrade`, `eval`, `review`, regenerating skills, ontology changes) does not: offer the same install. If the engine prints a version WARNING, suggest `/kb-setup upgrade`.

## Rules
- **One simple command per Bash call**, from the workspace root (auto mode; no `&&`, `;`, `|`). No MCP, hooks or settings changes.
- **Documents only in subagents:** anything beyond the compact output of `KB ask/show/query/page-text` (multi-page reading, Grep in raw/, image description, prose extraction) runs in a `general-purpose` subagent that returns only results with citations. Verify subagent output (file written, counts) and re-run if it returns suspiciously fast.
- **Never index `docs/`.** Prose extraction (`extract-llm`) only with explicit authorization for that document.
- **Answer in the user's language.** Cite every fact (`file, p.N` or `file, sheet X, row N`), say when a fact comes from a wiki note, repeat `ALERT`/`WARNING` lines, and say plainly when the KB has no answer.
- Read-only consumers (OneDrive teams): use `KB --read-only ...` or `KB_READONLY=1`; only the curator runs update.
- **Local copy check (OneDrive/both, once per session, before the first answer):** `KB audit --quick` compares this folder with `kb/inventory.json` (existence and size; it downloads nothing). If it reports MISSING or DIFFERENT files, say that answers may be incomplete because this copy is not fully synced, name the files, and point to `KB audit` (full sha256 check) for details. EXTRA files only mean the curator has not run update yet. No inventory (exit 2): ask the curator to run `/kb update`.

## /kb query "<question>" — aim for 1 call (2–3 at most)
1. `KB ask "<question or key terms>"` → most relevant entities with values already resolved by precedence (losers shown as `✗ superseded`), source to cite, RACI of activities, the `page-text` command for literal text, alerts. Options: `--limit N`, `--source <path fragment>` (repeatable). `WARNING: no entity covers all terms` = the answer may not be in the KB; `NO ANSWER IN KB` = nothing found.
2. Only if something is missing: saved queries `KB query <name>` (see `kb/queries/`; core ones: `conflicts`, `precedence`, `internal-inconsistencies`, `notes-review`, `deadlines`) or your own SPARQL (`SELECT DISTINCT`, prefixes added automatically; no RDFS inference — use concrete classes); `KB show <id:...|originalId|label>` for all statements with ✓/✗; `KB page-text "<.md>" <page>` for one page of literal text.
3. Thematic surveys in one call: {{THEMATIC_QUERY_HINT}}
4. Precedence (already applied): most recent wins (date, then version within a document family); raw/ wins over wiki/ unless a note lists it in `overrides:`. Topics/facts consolidate the same condition across documents (`id:topic/<name>`): tell the user when sources diverge.
5. Not in the KB → delegate a text search to a subagent (Grep in raw/*.md + `page-text`), say the source is the text, not the graph, and suggest a rule/mapping (see Suggestions).

### Schema summary (do not read the .ttl files to answer)
Core (`kb:` = http://kb.local/core#): Document/WikiNote (dcterms:source, dcterms:title, dcterms:modified, kb:version, kb:family, kb:overrides) · Section (`id:section/<family>/<number>`: rdfs:label, kb:number, kb:page, kb:excerpt, kb:parentSection, kb:references, kb:mentionsId) · Fact/Deadline topics (`id:topic/<name>`: kb:topic, kb:value or kb:duration/kb:date, kb:excerpt) · Deadline/Milestone · Activity/Role/Deliverable/RACIAssignment (kb:responsible/accountable/consulted/informed, kb:raciCode) · Decision/Hypothesis/Term (notes) · provenance on every instance: kb:definedIn + kb:page or kb:sheet/kb:row.
Domain (`{{PREFIX}}:`):
{{DOMAIN_SCHEMA}}
Per-source metadata (named graph `?g`): kb:layer, dcterms:modified, kb:versionKey, kb:reviewOverdue, kb:headerInferred.

## Maintenance
- `/kb status`: `KB status` (pending steps, lock, overdue notes, header inferred, duplicates, OneDrive conflict copies, `WILL NOT SYNC` files, engine version); on OneDrive/both also `KB audit --quick`.
- `/kb update` (curator): `KB lock --command-name update` → `KB update` → pending images to subagents (`KB pending-images --json`; prompt in `assets/templates/prompts.md` beside the engine: `~/.claude/skills/kb-setup/assets/templates/prompts.md` or `scripts/kb-engine/assets/templates/prompts.md`) → `KB update` (OneDrive/both: writes `kb/inventory.json` and lists `WILL NOT SYNC` files to rename) → graphify (required) in a subagent: `graphify update .` when only code changed, `/graphify . --update` when docs/, wiki/ or authorized raw/ files changed (respect `.graphifyignore`; GEMINI/GOOGLE keys must be unset) → `KB unlock` (rewrites the inventory to cover graphify-out/). If `graphify --version` differs from `graphify.version` in kb/config.yaml, stop and suggest `/kb-setup upgrade`. Report changes, new conflicts and suggestions.
- `/kb stale`: `KB stale` — alert only.
- `/kb new-note "<title>"`: `KB new-note "<title>" --type fleeting|literature|permanent [--source raw/...]`. When editing a note, update `last_reviewed` and `reviewed_by`. Conventions: `- Decision:`, `- Hypothesis:`, `- Assumption:`, `- Deadline: <milestone> = YYYY-MM-DD`, `- Term: <ACRONYM> = <definition>`, `- Condition: <topic> = <value>`, `[[links]]`.
- `/kb wiki`: `KB wiki` regenerates kb/wiki/.
- `/kb extract-llm <source>` (authorized only): `KB llm-context "<source>"` → one subagent with the prose-extraction prompt (`prompts.md`; full IRIs in `< >`, never `id:x/y`) → `KB validate` (≤3 fix rounds) → `KB llm-done "<source>"` → `KB wiki`.

## Suggestions
When you notice a signal (many calls for one theme, a contradiction the KB missed, unresolved references, repeated "not found"), end with a short **Suggestions** list and append it to `kb/IMPROVEMENTS.md`; `/kb-setup review` applies approved ones.
